fields.summary: TC-01: LRO Flag True When Actual Last Leg Arrival Delay > 120 Minutes

content.text: Precondition: A trip exists with planned and actual last leg arrival datetimes.
Given: planned last leg arrival = 2026-03-03T18:00:00Z, actual = 2026-03-03T20:05:00Z (125 min difference)
When: LRO lambda calculates leg override for the trip
Then: lroEligible flag is set to true
Out of Scope: LCO, RRO, Guarantees, Special Rules
